section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations of a single study examining caregiver eating messages and their relationships to body image and eating behavior in young adults. The study was limited to predominantly White, middle-class, first-year college students, and the authors acknowledge that findings may not generalize to more diverse populations. The section also outlines multiple directions for future research, including investigating caregiver eating messages across different developmental periods, exploring associations with eating disorders, and examining adaptive versus maladaptive eating messages.
